text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to a shrine with Fuji Kiseki, who hasn't been in top shape lately.
After finishing our prayers—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accompanying me.
I hope it wasn't too much of a bother?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...You know, this shrine is a place I often use for my solo training.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I thought coming here
might cheer me up a little, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh---!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? That voice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It sounded like Special Week and Silence Suzuka
had dashed up the stairs.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... You're amazing, Spe-chan.
For a moment there... *haa*... I thought you'd overtake me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!!
Suzuka-san, please, one more run!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course that's fine.
However... I won't be giving up the lead.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely going to overtake you, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The little ponies—
they're shining so brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're shining brighter than ever!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to say something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let me think...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Let's hold off on that for now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't want to disturb you while you're so focused.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Instead, let's pray once more
so that the pony-chans' hard work pays off.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is the least I can do
to thank you for firing up my fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if a weight had been lifted from her shoulders, Fuji Kiseki's face cleared up completely.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't find
the right words to say to them...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides... compared to those two
shining so brightly, the me right now is—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sorry. I brought up something a bit gloomy, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head back before the two of them notice us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki left the shrine
looking disheartened...
